The '''Godking's castle''' was the home of the [[Godking]], [[Trisstan]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Godking" />

==Description==
The [[Godking]]'s castle was situated in the center of Abonshee's largest [[City/Legends|city]] on the northern continent. Larger and grander than the [[Castle/Legends|castles]] inhabited by the [[Godling]]s, the Godking's castle was defended by forty-five guards. The Godking's throne room was a grand affair; a balcony run along both sides of the chamber, held up on fluted columns. [[Tapestry/Legends|Tapestries]] decorated the walls, and throne was situated in a prominent place.<ref name="Godking" />
